newsitem.title: JAPAN: TEPCO reactor to resume as planned despite pinhole.
newsitem.headline: TEPCO reactor to resume as planned despite pinhole.

text.p: Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc (TEPCO) said on Monday that it had found a pinhole on a metal case of one of the fuel rods at its reactor in northern Japan's Niigata prefecture during routine maintenance.
TEPCO, however, will bring the reactor back on line in early March as scheduled, after replacing the fuel unit that contains the defective rod, a company spokesman said.
The 1.1 million kilowatt reactor at TEPCO's Kashiwazaki Kariba nuclear power plant on the Japan Sea coast has been shut since December for routine checks.
